indicators.name: Population, total
indicators.description: De facto population: all residents regardless of legal status or citizenship. Values are midyear estimates. Midyear estimates are not census-date headcounts. In particular, WDI South Africa 2022 population differs from Stats SA Census 2022. Keep these datasets separate.

indicators.name: GDP growth (annual %)
indicators.description: Percentage change over each previous year of GDP at constant prices (base year 2015), expressed in United States dollars, as defined by the current WDI indicator metadata. Annual growth rates measure change, not economic size or household income. Historical records can be revised.
